name: Nickyboi's Cassiopeia Redesign

description:
# MOD INFORMATION

This skin replaces base Cassiopeia with a custom model and texture after Nickyboi's redesign. 

It is a Nickyboi design in collaboration with Erai Violett on concept art and Dwekou for Splash Art.

## CREDITS

* Designer: [Nickyboi](https://www.youtube.com/@NickyBoi)
* Concept Art: [Erai Violett](https://www.artstation.com/eraiviolett)
* Splash Art: [Dwekou](https://twitter.com/dwekou)
* Model, Texture, & VFX: [Bearded Shepherd](https://linktr.ee/BeardedShepherd)

## EXTRA INFOS

* If you would like to support me personally, **Bearded Shepherd**, with the models and textures I create for custom skins made completely from scratch, please consider donating to my [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/DanielMatosArtwork)!
* You can also check out the [artstation post on Cassiopeia's model](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/8bNkbQ) for a closer look.

Enjoy!
